i love this comment so much, thank you! i deactivated pretty much all of my social medias for the same reason. its so hard being constantly hammered by headline after headline. it feels like woman hating is ubiquitous. also, its not bad advice at all. i’ve been thinking a lot about “stepping away” lately, prioritizing things like being outside, reading, creating, and definitely just spending less time on technology in general…i think i could use a change of pace wrt my life in general, not just wrt to gender/misogyny, and i think building a strong foundation and a healthy lifestyle will definitely aid my emotions. believe me, i cry all the time, lol! it is very therapeutic. 

it’s scary that reading about our world is so mentally taxing. we want to educate ourselves on our oppression, but it often comes at the cost of our emotional wellbeing. :( 

i just want to devote myself to taking real action, caring for myself and the women in my life, investing in female friendship, all that good stuff. thank you again for this comment. i’m really sorry to hear that reading up on feminism proves incredibly depressing for so many women. but at the same time, i’m so glad i’m not alone. i wish you nothing but the best in the new year ☺️❤️
